title: Finite tape word
statement: For a tape $f\colon\mathbb{Z}\to\mathrm{Option}(\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\})$, define its tape word to be the unique finite Boolean word $w$ such that $f$ is the tape encoding of $w$, if such a word exists; if no such word exists, define the tape word to be the empty word.
caveat: The supplied snippet does not include the declaration header or the definition of the tape encoding; this rendering interprets the displayed body as the definition.
